title: Toward Third-Party Assurance of AI Systems: Design Requirements, Prototype, and Early Testing
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a procedural framework for third-party AI assurance and governance. While it includes 'Legal and Ethical Compliance' as a subcategory in its maturity matrix, this is a checklist for organizational processes and audits rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, moral philosophy, or ethical reasoning within the AI models themselves.
